explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/878: is it true that for almost all n, f(n) = o(n log log n) and F(n) ≫ n log log n? f(n) = Σ_{p|n} p^{⌊log_p n⌋}; F(n) is the max of Σ a_i over pairwise coprime a_i ∈ [2,n] whose prime factors divide n. Excluding a_i = 1 is the sensible reading, since otherwise F ≥ f + 1 always and the question 'f = F' would be vacuous. 'Almost all' is encoded as a density-1 set A with the asymptotics along A. The solved tag is backed by a linked Lean proof (Kitamura). Faithful.
